units.source_text: 七七佛事次第圆满之后，暂无举动。

en.t: After the forty-ninth-day Buddhist rites had all been completed in order, there was for the moment no further action.

units.source_text: 宫中闲静，皇上顿感寂寞无聊。

en.t: The palace grew quiet and still, and the Emperor suddenly felt lonely and bored.

units.source_text: 且说有一个僧都，藤壶母后的母后在世时就入宫供职，一直当祈祷师。

en.t: Now there was a certain high-ranking monk who had entered palace service while Empress Fujitsubo's mother was still alive and had long served as a prayer priest.

units.source_text: 藤壶母后也很尊敬他，当他亲信人。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo also respected him deeply and treated him as a trusted confidant.

units.source_text: 皇上亦重视他，常常教他举办隆重的法事。

en.t: The Emperor valued him as well and often had him conduct solemn Buddhist ceremonies.

units.source_text: 这确是一个道行高深的圣僧，世间少有。

en.t: He was truly a holy monk of profound spiritual attainment, rare in the world.

units.source_text: 他今年约七十岁，近年来笼闭山中，勤修佛法，为自己晚年积福。

en.t: He was about seventy years old that year, and in recent years he had secluded himself in the mountains, diligently practicing the Buddhist law and storing up merit for his old age.

units.source_text: 此次专为藤壶母后祈病，来到京都，被召入宫，常侍皇上左右。

en.t: This time he had come to the capital especially to pray for Empress Fujitsubo's recovery, and after being summoned into the palace he remained constantly in attendance near the Emperor.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣也劝他：“今后你就同昔日一样，常住宫中，为皇上供职。”

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, also urged him, saying, "From now on, stay in the palace as you did in the past and serve His Majesty."

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“贫僧年老，本已不堪夜课。

en.t: The monk replied, "This poor monk is old and can no longer endure the night services.
Yet since the Minister commands it, how could I dare to refuse?

units.source_text: 况长年身蒙厚恩，理应报答。”

en.t: Moreover, I have received great kindness for many years, so it is only right that I repay it."
And so he remained living in the palace.
